task_specification.objective: Deliver the revised gameplay HUD and quest journal with correct camera/UI input ownership, repair Load focus visibility and global mute propagation, and provide a bounded handoff for independent validation of the unchanged frozen gates.

diagnosis.root_cause: The selected gameplay interface still follows prototype presentation paths: preview_controller creates persistent objective, interaction and F10 cards; combat_hud creates a permanent checkpoint/life text card; there is no ordinary journal-opening branch in the inspected input owner. dialogue_state additionally clamps restored lives to three and rejects saves above three, preventing faithful four/five-life presentation. player_controller handles mouse motion with fixed sensitivity, has no inspected wheel branch, and rewrites spring length from constants every archery update. Separately, Load grabs Return focus before deferred reflow finishes, consistent with QA's empty-slot clipping measurements; the precise layout timing remains a hypothesis to test. Mute is persisted but applied to selected cue producers rather than all output, matching independently captured forest ambience leakage. Missing resolution, pointer, fault-recovery and asset-qualification observations are measurement debt, not proof of additional product failure.

stop_conditions: Finish this module's candidate implementation and focused Developer smoke before handing it to Host/Tester; do not expand into another gameplay or presentation phase.

If authorized pointer, resize, audio capture or isolated fault fixtures remain unavailable, continue useful candidate repairs but leave the corresponding acceptance blocked. Do not substitute direct self-drives, state setters, screenshots at another resolution or source inspection.
Do not claim later chapter life awards or chapter recovery are implemented merely because icons or restored four/five-life histories render correctly.
Retain failures and unresolved resource qualification honestly; only independent Host/Tester results close issues and the phase gate.

Retire the product's persistent HUD cards and adapt native themed journal/HUD controls to dialogue_state. Repair camera target ownership in the existing player_controller rather than activating a second controller. Compare missing life/journal artwork with the locally indexed Kenney resources before binding it. The three bounded causal groups are shared HUD/c

investigation.expected_observation: If deferred layout timing causes clipping, the focused Return rectangle falls outside its clipping ancestors after reflow despite valid focus; the repair keeps its complete rectangle visible after final layout in both slot states. Camera probing shows the current constant overwrite and then stable user target distance, temporary collision shortening and restoration. Muted baseline capture reveals.
investigation.hypothesis: Shared UI and camera state changes are applied at different lifecycle boundaries: Load focus precedes final layout, camera distance is overwritten during archery updates, and mute bypasses ambient producers.
investigation.probe: Run one bounded baseline/change/retest sequence. In the empty 200% Load scenario observe focus and clipping-ancestor rectangles after layout settles; compare populated slots. During ordinary positive/negative wheel inputs observe the existing camera target and collision distance across frames and modal boundaries. Pair normal/muted Master-output captures with the saved preference and live ambient.
